## MactsRuntime interface

The Mac-side runtime every macts surface dispatches operations through.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface MactsRuntime
```

<tbody><tr><td>

[invoke(id, input, context)](./runtime.mactsruntime.invoke.md)

</td><td>

Run one operation through the full invocation pipeline.

An operation marked `unavailable` (one whose required input admits no value, D7) is answered exactly as an unknown id: the same `ValidationError`<!-- -->, after the credential is verified and the call admitted, and before permission, governance or approval, so no human is ever asked to approve a call that cannot run.

A caller whose key lacks the operation's permission is denied after admission and before its input is looked at, and the denial is audited as `permission-denied`<!-- -->, a record that is the same whatever the input.

Input is validated after the permission check and before governance. A call rejected by validation is audited as `invalid-input`<!-- -->, with its issue count and none of its arguments, and nobody is asked to approve it. An input key that is not a declared parameter is invalid input, whether the operation was registered from a manifest or a contract. Audit and approval records of a governed call summarize only the operation's declared parameters, from the validated input; any other key that reaches them anyway is counted as `unknownKeys`<!-- -->, never named.

</td></tr>
